Chay ke sath kuchh kurkura aur chatapta ho jae! ( ) Crispy Methi Mathri, masaledar Kachori aur khasta Namak Pare, sath men khatti-mithi Tomato Chutney. ye mazedar Indian Tea Time Snacks har chhoti-bari bhukh ke lie perfect hain!
Preparation time 10-15 minutes
Cooking time 15-20 minutes
Serve 2-4
Ingredients
For Tomato Chutney
2-3 tbsp Oil, tel
1 inch Ginger (peeled & roughly chopped), adrak
